description: This Java interface 'EnforcementConfig' provides configuration settings for the enforcement behavior in the Eclipse Ditto Concierge service. It defines methods to obtain configuration values such as timeout durations, buffer sizes, and dispatching options. It also includes an enum 'EnforcementConfigValue' with known configuration paths and default values.

classes.name: EnforcementConfig
classes.description: An interface defining configuration settings related to enforcement behavior in the system.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration to wait for entity shard regions.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the buffer size used for the queue in the enforcer actor.

methods.name: shouldDispatchLiveResponsesGlobally
methods.description: Indicates whether live responses from channels should be dispatched globally.

enums.name: EnforcementConfigValue
enums.description: Enumeration of known configuration path expressions and their default values for EnforcementConfig.

constants.name: ASK_TIMEOUT
constants.description: The ask timeout duration, defaulting to 10 seconds.

constants.name: BUFFER_SIZE
constants.description: The buffer size for the queue, defaulting to 1000.

constants.name: GLOBAL_LIVE_RESPONSE_DISPATCHING
constants.description: Flag to enable dispatching live responses globally, defaulting to false.
